# roomtone

my little pile of scripts for cleaning and slating field recordings before they go in a library.

- denoise.py — spectral gate tuned for HVAC floors, doesn't eat the top end
- slate.py — writes the metadata slate (location, date, mic, gain) into the wav's bext chunk so future-me knows what past-me did

not pretty. mine.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""transcribe a session locally with whisper. LOCAL. no cloud, no api, ever, for resident material.
this is the one rule I don't break. the machine is offline when this runs."""
import sys, whisper

def main(path):
    model = whisper.load_model("large-v3")
    # word timestamps so I can line up the [inaudible] gaps by hand afterward
    result = model.transcribe(path, word_timestamps=True, language="en", fp16=False)
    out = path.rsplit(".", 1)[0] + ".json"
    import json; json.dump(result, open(out, "w"))
    print(f"wrote {out}")
    print("now do the gaps by hand. the machine can't hear grief. you have to.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1])
